name: Ting
description:
Ting is a unique non-alcoholic sparkling beverage crafted in Malaysia, blending the sweetness of grapefruit with a subtle herbal complexity. It's characterized by a refreshing, clean taste profile achieved through a careful balance of fruit and botanicals. The resulting liquid offers a pleasing effervescence and a delicate aroma that makes it a versatile mixer or a delightful standalone drink.

Beyond its taste, Ting's appeal lies in its versatility. It complements a wide range of flavors, enhancing rather than overpowering other ingredients. Its subtle sweetness and herbaceous undertones make it an exceptional accompaniment to a variety of foods, from savory to sweet, and provides an interesting dimension to its pairings.
